seo.title: Making Tax Digital for Barbers: The £30,000 Test Explained
seo.description: Making Tax Digital for Income Tax reaches self-employed barbers above £30,000 of takings from April 2027. Who is in scope, what to record, and the deadlines.

media.alt: Three Making Tax Digital Income Tax start dates: 6 April 2026 if 2024/25 qualifying income over £50,000; 6 April 2027 if 2025/26 income over £30,000; 6 April 2028 if 2026/27 income over £20,000
